caseName: California Public Employees' Retirement System v. Arnett
caseNameFull: California Public Employees' Retirement System v. Arnett

opinions.text:
C. A. 9th Cir. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of Kimel v. Florida Bd. of Regents, ante, p. 62.

Justice Breyer took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
